title: Best Ever Banana Bread from I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!
description: This super moist and delicious banana bread made with I Can't Believe It's Not Butter is easy to make and a great go-to snack for the entire family.
authors: I Can't Believe its Not Butter
ingredients: 1 cup I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!® Spread
0.75 cup firmly packed light brown sugar

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Brush a 9x5-inch loaf pan with I Can't Believe It's Not Butter! Spread; set aside.

Beat together 1 cup I Can't Believe It's Not Butter! Spread, mashed bananas, brown sugar, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl with a wooden spoon until well combined. Stir in flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt until blended. Spoon batter into the prepared loaf pan.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 60 to 70 minutes. Cool on a wire rack for 20 minutes. Remove loaf from the pan and let cool completely on the rack.
